source_response: Training-only robust source consensus; unchanged V11 noise65 integer emitter.
metric_fixes: Wilcoxon no continuity correction, tie correction
NMAE minimum 10 real-significant genes and finite nonzero denominator
reach=0 for nonempty real budget with no adjudicable genes
selection_rules: Freeze a candidate using development only before opening new count confirmation. Treat a failed confirmation as failure and do not retune against it.
Exclude the whole evaluated source family, including all platforms and correlated releases. Keep common target-independent templates and independent references.
Require complete six-metric panels; equal-weight source families and technical strata; paired seeds. Report worst-family and actual-cell-count limitations.
Protect V11 fidelity and reach: no aggregate fall greater than 0.01; no family fall greater than 0.03. NMAE must not worsen by more than 0.01. PDS must not fall more than 0.02.
Expression error must improve on development and confirmation. Treat these provisional tolerances as fixed screening rules, not an official anchored score estimate.
Report neutral-call fraction and detection/variance errors in every context; do not claim a null-safety pass from a mean across contexts. Do not inflate observed sample size by duplicating cells.
Limit the initial count-stage to at most four candidates including V11; source, response and emitter changes must be tested separately before combination.
confirmation_policy: Choose using development only. Evaluate baseline and frozen candidate once on reserved count confirmation; do not retune after failure.
power_amendment: Add strong development cases chosen from previously inspected full-source normal-q summaries and cell counts. Additional confirmation uses the same metadata only; summary biology is not blind. Keep all original reserved confirmation targets, including low-power ones. H1 is development only.
scope: Public whole-family held-out tests, two new seeds, actual <=400 cells without duplication, shared 400-cell template, independent 400/full controls. Private competition anchors unavailable.
selection_policy: Six-metric whole-family-balanced primary full-independent references; sampled400 secondary with explicit missing NMAE. Original raw guards applied on available secondary metrics; primary must be complete. Choose greatest mean relative expression-error reduction among candidates passing guards, then assess once on reserved count confirmation. Failure means exploratory package only, never a claimed gain.
